justification: Conveyancer free-check report for 38 Park Rd Bowral showed the wrong title type: the cadastre query's always-20m buffer captured the NEIGHBOUR's strata scheme (SP105471) and first-SP-wins confirmed it, cascading into three wrong feasibility cards. Fix makes point-in-polygon decide (buffer only as no-hit fallback needing address corroboration), drops the statewide SEPP R&H 'Land Application' polygon from hazard overlays (false coastal hit on every NSW property), hides lot_size from the hazard UI section, dedupes SEPP rows in the free check, and scrubs hook-exported GIT_DIR from qa_gate diff-scoping subprocesses (worktree pushes failed the test suite).

pre_impl.existing_data: detect_strata/get_cadastral_info already existed in scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py and are consumed by services/conveyancing.py (is_strata feeds calc_feasibility and the Title Type banner) and services/intelligence_brief.py (classify_strata + StrataHub lot-count enrichment). climate_risk_score.py already contained the 'Land Application covers all NSW, only Subject Land is a hazard' rule; the PDF path already deduped SEPP rows by (name, type) while the free-check UI did not.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old code assumed any SP/CP lot within 20 m of the property centroid belonged to the subject property. Live reproduction showed the point-in-polygon result for 38 Park Rd Bowral is exactly one Torrens lot (12/DP702113) while the 20 m buffer adds two neighbouring strata schemes; the buffer exists only for imprecise geocodes, not as the primary signal.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism or data source: the same cadastre endpoint is queried in two stages (containment first, buffer fallback), a containment flag is threaded through the existing dict contract (all previous keys preserved), the coastal filter mirrors the existing _normalize_coastal rule, and the UI changes are render-time filters over data already fetched.

functions.name: get_cadastral_info
functions.input: lat/lng WGS84 point from resolve_address lot centroid or coordinate-first resolution
functions.output: dict with is_strata, strata_plan, plan_type, parent_has_strata, plan_label, lot_number plus new containment flag stating whether returned lots actually contain the point
functions.if_none: on request exception or empty results from both stages it returns the all-False dict with containment False, so detect_strata falls through to the address heuristic exactly as before

functions.name: detect_strata
functions.input: street address string plus optional lat/lng coordinates for the cadastre lookup
functions.output: strata_info dict consumed by calc_feasibility, the Title Type banner and intelligence_brief classify_strata; containment-confirmed SP keeps source cadastre, buffered SP needs unit-style address and is marked cadastre+address
functions.if_none: with no coordinates or no cadastre hits the pre-existing address-heuristic fallback returns is_strata from the unit-prefix regex with source address_heuristic

functions.name: _drop_jurisdictional_overlays
functions.input: deduped overlay row dicts from the spatial_overlays PostGIS query in get_unique_overlays
functions.output: same rows minus coastal_land_application rows whose value is not Subject Land, so the statewide jurisdictional polygon never renders as a hazard
functions.if_none: empty input list returns empty list unchanged and a missing value key is treated as not Subject Land so the row is dropped rather than shown as a false coastal hazard

functions.name: changed_line_numbers
functions.input: changed file paths plus the project directory whose git history should be queried
functions.output: mapping of file to changed line numbers computed against the merge-base with origin/main, now immune to hook-exported GIT_DIR redirecting the subprocess to another repo
functions.if_none: when no git base is resolvable it returns an empty dict and callers keep ALL findings as the safe full-scan fallback

values.value: cadastre classsubtype (3=strata, 4=community) and hasstratum (2=scheme present) attributes
values.if_missing: attribute absent means the lot is not counted as SP/CP unless the planlabel prefix says otherwise, matching pre-existing behaviour

values.value: spatial_overlays.value for coastal_land_application rows (Land Application vs Subject Land)
values.if_missing: null or empty value is not Subject Land so the row is dropped, which fails toward not showing an unverifiable coastal designation

queries.purpose: spatial_overlays overlay fetch feeding the free check, PDF and intelligence brief
queries.where_clause: layer_type IN (env layers) AND ST_Intersects(geom, lot polygon) with ST_Contains centroid fallback — unchanged; the fix is a post-filter on the returned rows

break_it.scenario: Torrens house adjacent to a strata townhouse complex, geocode lands correctly inside the lot (the live 38 Park Rd Bowral case)
break_it.what_happens: containment query returns only the DP lot so the neighbour's SP never enters classification; report shows Torrens title with the correct DP number
break_it.how: test_torrens_lot_ignores_neighbouring_sp_in_buffer pins that the buffer query is not consulted when the point hits a lot; live-verified against the real cadastre API
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cadastral_plan_type.py::test_torrens_lot_ignores_neighbouring_sp_in_buffer -q; live: POST /api/satellite/conveyancing {"address": "38 Park Rd, Bowral NSW 2576"}

break_it.scenario: genuine strata apartment where the geocoded point sits inside the SP scheme polygon
break_it.what_happens: stage-1 containment returns the SP lot and strata is confirmed with source cadastre exactly as before the change
break_it.how: test_contained_sp_lot_still_confirms_strata plus live verification of 5/1 Treacy Street Hurstville returning SP91614
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cadastral_plan_type.py::test_contained_sp_lot_still_confirms_strata -q; live: detect_strata('5/1 Treacy Street, Hurstville NSW 2220', -33.96, 151.10)

break_it.scenario: imprecise geocode lands on the road so the point hits no lot and the 20 m fallback returns a neighbouring SP for a non-unit address
break_it.what_happens: strata is NOT confirmed; the result degrades to the ambiguous parent_has_strata path instead of asserting the neighbour's plan number
break_it.how: test_buffer_fallback_sp_alone_is_ambiguous_not_strata and test_buffer_fallback_sp_plus_unit_address_confirms pin both directions of the fallback

break_it.scenario: property genuinely inside a SEPP R&H Subject Land coastal designation
break_it.what_happens: the Subject Land row survives the jurisdictional filter and still renders as a coastal overlay in the free check and PDF
break_it.how: test_subject_land_row_is_kept plus live query of a real Subject Land point (-33.8644, 151.2512) returning the row after the filter

break_it.scenario: cadastre API down or timing out during a conveyancer run
break_it.what_happens: both stages raise inside the existing try/except, the all-False dict returns and detect_strata falls back to the address heuristic as before the change
break_it.how: unchanged exception envelope around both queries; test_no_cadastre_result_falls_back_to_address_heuristic covers the empty-result path
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cadastral_plan_type.py::test_no_cadastre_result_falls_back_to_address_heuristic -q (both cadastre stages mocked empty)

break_it.scenario: push from a git worktree where the hook exports an absolute GIT_DIR
break_it.what_happens: qa_gate diff-scoping subprocesses previously resolved the wrong repo and a unit test failed on every worktree push; now the env is scrubbed and cwd decides
break_it.how: test_hook_exported_git_dir_does_not_leak sets GIT_DIR to the real repo and asserts the non-repo tmp dir still yields the empty full-scan fallback

post_merge.db_reset: none — no schema or data changes; the statewide Land Application rows stay in spatial_overlays for climate_risk_score which filters them itself
post_merge.manual_verify: run the free conveyancer check for 38 Park Rd Bowral NSW 2576 on the preview deployment: expect Torrens title (DP702113), feasibility cards no longer strata-blocked, no coastal land application row, no lot size row under hazards, one SEPP Sustainable Buildings row
